milestone_title: Phase-9 Dynamic Constraint Elicitation, FR-11 Consolidation, and Hardware-Offloaded Verification

task_outcomes.title: PyO3 gateway for KV260 hardware offloading
task_outcomes.notes: Rust bindings for UIO AXI-Lite register map implemented. Gate checks for downstream exp1711 required a JSON pytest_passed field, but exp1710's deliverable is a code file. Gate mis-configuration caused the cascade block on exp1711.

task_outcomes.title: Ablation of Eidoku Gate using KV260 hardware offloading
task_outcomes.blocked_by: exp1710-kv260-pyo3-gateway (upstream artifact not found for pytest_passed field)
task_outcomes.notes: Blocked at conductor_pre_gate. Root cause: exp1710's deliverable is a .rs code file, not a JSON with pytest_passed. The gate spec should have gated on the code file's existence, not a JSON field.

task_outcomes.title: Semantic pruning for FR-11 continual learning
task_outcomes.notes: SemanticPruner class implemented using Jaccard similarity at 0.85 threshold. Same gate mismatch pattern as exp1710 — code deliverable, not JSON.

task_outcomes.title: Evaluate FR-11 semantic pruning on long-horizon tasks
task_outcomes.blocked_by: exp1712-fr11-semantic-pruning (upstream artifact not found for pytest_passed field)
task_outcomes.notes: Blocked at conductor_pre_gate. Same gate mis-configuration pattern: exp1712 produced a .py module, not a JSON artifact with pytest_passed.

task_outcomes.title: Instruct-to-Constraint extraction from free-text
task_outcomes.notes: PromptConstraintExtractor implemented (ROCE approach, arXiv:2605.01124). Dual-layer: deterministic regex rules + optional LLM layer under CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1.

task_outcomes.title: Synthesizing Dynamic Eidoku Gates
task_outcomes.notes: CompiledEidokuGate implemented; runtime constraint graph compiled from extracted DynamicConstraints.

task_outcomes.title: Live evaluation of zero-shot dynamic constraint generation
task_outcomes.blocked_by: exp1715-dynamic-eidoku-synth (upstream artifact not found for pytest_passed field)
task_outcomes.notes: Blocked at conductor_pre_gate. Same pattern: exp1715 produced a .py module, not a JSON. Live evaluation of dynamic extraction not possible this milestone.

task_outcomes.title: Integrate Energy-Guided Decoder with Dynamic Eidoku
task_outcomes.blocked_reason: Rerun discipline enforcement — missing prior_failures for exp1636-energy-guided-decoding and exp1654-energy-guided-decoding
task_outcomes.notes: Code deliverable (hiled_decoder.py) was produced, but the conductor correctly blocked result-JSON completion because the task reused scope from two prior failed energy-guided-decoding experiments without documenting a prior_failures block. The code asset is preserved; the experiment needs a prior_failures entry naming exp1636 and exp1654 to proceed in a subsequent milestone.

task_outcomes.title: Evaluate Hallucination Mitigation using HILED and GloroKAN
task_outcomes.notes: No HILED accuracy/mitigation effectiveness data this milestone. Only latency data from exp1719 is available.

task_outcomes.title: Measure inference latency impact of HILED
task_outcomes.notes: Latency cost of HILED projection quantified. The ~2.34 ms/token projection tax is substantial and must be weighed against effectiveness (not yet measured — exp1718 blocked). This data is necessary for any latency-accuracy trade-off analysis in paper-v6.

task_outcomes.title: E2E Pipeline Evaluation (Dynamic Extract + HW + Continual Learning)
task_outcomes.notes: Full pipeline ran successfully on 100 scenarios across 2 SOTA models. FR-11 CERCE ledger: promotion gate passed, 0 accepted violations, nonforgetting_rate=1.0. pruned_constraints=0 indicates the semantic pruner found no redundant constraints in this corpus — consistent with a newly initialized replay buffer.

milestone_completion_rate.notes: 8 of 13 planned tasks produced their deliverable artifacts. 5 were blocked at conductor_pre_gate. None failed due to agent error or test failure — all blocks were structural (gate mis-config or rerun discipline enforcement).

hiled_vs_cpu_comparison.finding: HILED projection tax is 2.34 ms/token versus 0.0002 ms/token for CPU-only baseline — approximately 10,908x overhead per token.
hiled_vs_cpu_comparison.accuracy_blocked_by: exp1718 blocked due to exp1717 rerun discipline gate failure
hiled_vs_cpu_comparison.recommendation_for_next_milestone: The HILED latency cost is known; effectiveness is unknown. Next milestone must include prior_failures block for exp1636 and exp1654 in the energy-guided-integration task, then re-run exp1718 to get accuracy/mitigation data. Without both sides of the trade-off, HILED cannot be paper-v6-headlined.
hiled_vs_cpu_comparison.decentralization_note: HILED operates on top of local GGUF inference — no closed-weight dependency. Projection tax is hardware-portable and will run on NPU/CPU paths.

dynamic_vs_static_extraction.finding: Dynamic extraction infrastructure (ROCE-style PromptConstraintExtractor + CompiledEidokuGate) was successfully delivered in exp1714 and exp1715. Live evaluation (exp1716) was blocked due to gate mis-configuration. The exp1720 E2E run exercised the pipeline with pruned_constraints=0, consistent with no semantic-redundancy in the 100-case corpus.
dynamic_vs_static_extraction.live_eval_blocked_by: exp1715 gate checked for pytest_passed JSON field on a code-only deliverable
dynamic_vs_static_extraction.recommendation_for_next_milestone: Fix gate configuration: tasks whose deliverable is a code file (not a JSON) should be gated by file-existence checks, not by artifact_field=pytest_passed. This would unblock exp1713, exp1716, and similar downstream evaluations. Alternatively, require code-deliverable tasks to also write a companion results/experiment_NNNN_impl.json with pytest_passed field.

root_cause_analysis.primary_blocker: Gate specification mismatch: experiments producing code deliverables (.rs, .py) were gated downstream via artifact_field=pytest_passed, which requires a JSON artifact. The conductor correctly blocked on missing artifact, but the block cascaded through 3 downstream experiments (exp1711, exp1713, exp1716).
root_cause_analysis.secondary_blocker: Rerun discipline enforcement on exp1717 (energy-guided-decoding scope reused from exp1636 and exp1654 without prior_failures block). This is the conductor working as designed — the fix is in the next roadmap, not in conductor code.

operational_findings.finding: Code-deliverable tasks need a companion JSON artifact or the downstream gate spec must use file-existence checks instead of artifact_field=pytest_passed.
operational_findings.action: Update gate convention in next roadmap; document in ops/known-issues.md

operational_findings.finding: Rerun discipline correctly blocked exp1717 (energy-guided-decoding scope). The hiled_decoder.py code was still produced. Next milestone re-proposal must include prior_failures for exp1636 and exp1654.
operational_findings.action: Add prior_failures block to exp1717 re-proposal in next roadmap

operational_findings.finding: HILED latency overhead (10,908x per token) is substantial. Without accuracy data (exp1718 blocked), the latency-accuracy trade-off is undocumented. This risks over-claiming HILED value in paper-v6.
operational_findings.action: Priority in next milestone: unblock exp1717 chain → exp1718 accuracy measurement

operational_findings.finding: exp1720 E2E succeeded with 2 SOTA models, 0 accepted violations, and nonforgetting_rate=1.0. The FR-11 CERCE ledger is working correctly. This is the strongest empirical result of the milestone.
operational_findings.action: Include in paper-v6 continual learning section as concrete milestone evidence
